note: R-109 review artefact read by hooks/git-workflow-guard.sh at the PR head. The range narrows the security-surface path trigger for test files. Round 1 (33a7e61) raised 1 to 6, addressed in f251181. Round 2 (82fb63d) verified 1 to 6 fixed and raised 7 and 8; the Codex R-517 round on the same head raised the same class (executable comments such as # frozen_string_literal:, a mode change beside a comment). All are addressed in 5f3e3d642506781f0058d86edbe403bd470849a5 with failing cases first: the exemption became an allowlist of fixture-runner metadata (# Shard: slow|serial, # Watches:, # Covers:, blank) inside the file's leading comment header in its own revision, with the file mode and type unchanged. Round 3 (Codex R-517 on dfef985) showed diff parsing could still be misled (inter-hunk context lines, metadata inserted above the shebang); fb38e94 replaced it with a whole-blob comparison: a *.test.sh fixture is exempt only when its two blobs are byte-identical after removing # Shard:, # Watches:, # Covers:, and blank lines from each leading comment header (line 1 always kept), with the mode unchanged. Every other test file keeps its hit. The review of the head that adds this text is the PR body's Security review section.
